note.zh: galcom.66（隐藏）在提名期后：有提名星球 → 68 新总部成立；否则 69 / 70 总部不动。
note.en: Hidden galcom.66 after the nomination period: a nominee planet -> 68 the new headquarters; otherwise 69 / 70 the market stays.

label.zh: 失去总部后：市场能否重新成立
label.en: After losing the headquarters: market re-established or not

notes.zh: 入口一：成员离开社群（on_remove_community_member → 62）而其星球是市场总部；入口二：迁移决议通过（galcom.64）。
notes.en: Entry one: a member leaves the community (on_remove_community_member -> 62) and its planet is the market headquarters; entry two: the relocation resolution passes (galcom.64).

scope.zh: 银河市场总部：失去总部后的寻找、迁移决议与新总部的成立。
scope.en: Galactic Market headquarters: the search after losing it, the relocation resolution and the new headquarters.

uncertain: The initial founding of the market (action.96/97) is not in my list; only the headquarters-lost and relocation lines are covered.
